title: Token tiers
about: Primitive (reference or global) tokens hold raw values, semantic (system or alias) tokens name a purpose and point at primitives, and component tokens name one component's use of a semantic token. Components read semantic or component tokens, never primitives, so a theme or rebrand changes one layer. The owners place tokens by path prefix or by ID.

tiers.title: primitive token
tiers.description: A raw value, such as a palette color or a size on the spacing scale.

tiers.title: semantic token
tiers.description: A purpose, such as the brand background, pointing at a primitive.

tiers.title: component token
tiers.description: One component's use of a semantic token, such as the button's background.
